materialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: isolated material source sprites for a real modular 2D platformer tileset, NOT a scene or a mockup.
Use the first reference for the accepted warm honey limestone material, crisp cream chipped top highlight, warm ochre bevel and dark brown outline. Use the second only for finish quality, not for its inconsistent stone sizes.
Create a clean transparent sprite material sheet with precisely 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 fully separated objects, centered in equal grid slots. Large transparent gutters between objects. No text, labels, grid, background, shadow outside objects, scenery or props. Orthographic FRONT view, absolutely no perspective, no top plane projected back in depth. Hand-painted polished indie game stone, a few broad deliberate facets, crisp readable bevels, tiny restrained chips, no random grain or excessive cracks. Each object must have straight parallel overall edges and a neat thin dark contour.
ROW 1: four variations of one horizontal warm limestone brick each, width:height exactly 2:1; luminous cream narrow WALKABLE TOP rim, tan front face, modest dark bottom bevel. Identical shape sizes and same global upper-left lighting.
ROW 2: four variations of a SQUARE half brick, width:height exactly 1:1; same physical height as every stone in row 1, half their width. The stone is for VERTICAL WALL facing, so very restrained upper rim, side bevel visible, no wide brilliant walkable white band. Warm tan face similar brightness to row 1. All square.
ROW 3: four variations of one horizontal UNDERSIDE limestone brick each, width:height exactly 2:1, same width/height as row 1. More muted warm brown face, readable crisp bevel, NO brilliant white top rim, NO multiple vertical lines across the face. One whole stone with only perimeter edge.
ROW 4: four variations of one WOOD DECK segment, width:height exactly 8:3, same width as rows 1 and 3. Warm walnut timber, slim light upper lip, dark undersurface, refined painted grain. First two are plain repeating wooden segments with straight ends and NO iron; third has one iron cap on LEFT only, fourth iron cap on RIGHT only. Iron cap fully inside same width. No nails or brackets extending below the allocated height.
All masonry stone heights are identical between rows. In rows 1–3 square half stones have exactly the same height as rectangular full stones. One object per slot, 16 objects total. True transparent background. Render clean high detail at large size for carefully normalized 32x16 / 16x16 / 32x12 game source pieces. Do NOT include assembled L shapes or terrain. Do NOT draw tall 1:2 stones. Do NOT add cast shadows. This is a sprite source sheet, not a finished 32px atlas.
